subtitle.en: UPESSC PGT (Lecturer) · subject code 08 · topic-wise notes on the official 2026 syllabus

about.en: The units follow the official 2026 syllabus of PGT Mathematics. Each topic keeps the full text of the notes PDF, with explanations, worked examples and shortcuts added. Chapter 1 of the notes is ready; the other chapters are being added.
